name: Zap2XML
description:
Create an XMLTV EPG from Zap2it (single or multiple lineups).

FORK BUILD (tylertufano): adds lineup channel numbers to Gracenote station display names and serializes downloads across Dispatcharr worker processes.
author: jesmannstl (fork: tylertufano)

fields.label: Lineup IDs
fields.help_text: Only enter lineupId strings. Country and ZIP/postal are auto-derived per lineup.

fields.label: Merge multiple lineups into a single XMLTV
fields.help_text: If enabled, all generated lineups are merged into one XML and one EPG Source.

fields.label: Total hours to fetch
fields.help_text: Total hours of guide data to fetch (requested in 6-hour chunks).

fields.label: Delay between requests (sec)
fields.help_text: Seconds to sleep between chunk requests to Zap2it.

fields.label: HTTP User-Agent (optional)
fields.help_text: Override HTTP User-Agent when fetching from Zap2it. Leave blank to use the plugin's global default.

fields.label: Refresh Interval (hours)
fields.help_text: Auto-refresh interval for the EPG source (0 to disable).

fields.label: Auto-Download XML on Schedule
fields.help_text: When enabled, download a new XMLTV file on the saved interval.

fields.label: EPG Name
fields.help_text: Base name for the EPG Source(s) added to Dispatcharr.

fields.label: Station Logo Style
fields.help_text: Choose a station logo style for the XMLTV guide.

fields.label: Include Programme Artwork
fields.help_text: Include artwork icons on listings in the XMLTV guide.

fields.label: Programme Artwork Style
fields.help_text: Choose an artwork style for listings on stations mapped to this guide.

fields.label: Require confirmation
fields.help_text: Confirm before generating and importing the EPG

actions.label: Download EPG XML
actions.description: Fetch Zap2it data and write XML under /data/epgs. Updates/creates the EPG source(s).

confirm.title: Download EPG XML?
confirm.message: This fetches a new XMLTV file using the listed lineup IDs and updates the EPG source(s).

actions.label: Set Channels + Logos
actions.description: Match channels by name to EPG tvg_ids and set logos.

confirm.title: Set channels + logos?
confirm.message: Matches by channel name. Sets EPG and logos from channels.db or XMLTV icons.
